title: Transient object-store classifier is shared; edits change retry behavior across pipeline
answers: What does adding to TRANSIENT_OBJECT_STORE_ERRORS affect
Which S3 errors are retried in delta pipeline
body: `is_transient_object_store_error` (pipelines/core/delta/errors.py) is shared by `copy_file`, `vacuum`, `compact`, `DeltaTable.is_deltatable()` and `delete_folder` in data_imports/util.py. Adding a message to `TRANSIENT_OBJECT_STORE_ERRORS` both retries the operation and suppresses error-tracking capture everywhere, so only add idempotent, self-clearing conditions. Matching is by message substring (S3's fixed text), and each entry has an explanatory comment above the tuple; keep that pattern. Test cases live in pipelines/core/delta/test/test_delta_errors.py::TestIsTransientObjectStoreError.
applies: Any change to transient error classification in warehouse_sources data_imports

search: The shared is_transient_object_store_error classifier (pipelines/core/delta/errors.py) and TRANSIENT_OBJECT_STORE_ERRORS tuple control retry and error-tracking suppression for copy_file, vacuum, compact, DeltaTable.is_deltatable(), and delete_folder in data_imports/util.py. Adding a message substring to the tuple enables retries and suppresses error capture everywhere, so only add idempotent, self-clearing conditions; each entry must have an explanatory comment above the tuple. Matching is by exact message substring (e.g., fixed S3 text), and test cases in pipelines/core/delta/test/test_delta_errors.py::TestIsTransientObjectStoreError must cover new patterns. Any change to warehouse_sources data_imports transient error classification affects all delta pipeline operations simultaneously.
